ticket.summary: After-hours text: garbage disposal humming/not spinning due to a peach pit; customer cleared it herself with PB-07 steps, no visit needed.
mitigation_advice: Unplug the disposal or switch off its breaker before doing anything; never reach into the unit [PB-07]
Remove visible debris with tongs/pliers, not fingers [PB-07]
Use the hex/Allen socket under the unit to work the flywheel back and forth until free [PB-07]
Restore power, press the red reset button underneath, then test with cold water running [PB-07]

quote_lines.description: Disposal jam clearing — quoted as contingency only; customer resolved it herself, work not performed

ticket.customer_message: Amazing — peach pit strikes again! 🎉 Nice work, that's a proper DIY win. Two quick tips going forward: keep pits, bones, and fibrous stuff (celery, corn husks) out of it, and always run cold water a few seconds after grinding. If it ever hums again and the wrench doesn't free it, that usually means the motor rather than a jam — text us and we'll take a look. No charge for tonight, and thanks for calling Brookdale!
